system.description:
You conjure a clone made of water similar to the Shadow clone technique but with far less power, known as a Water Clone. Water Clone’s weigh half as much as the caster.

When this jutsu is cast, by spending 8 chakra, you summon one Clone. You can spend 4 additional chakra to summon 1 additional Clone. You can spend 4 additional chakra in this way to summon additional Clones up to 3 times per casting.

Water Clones can on cast ninjutsu with the Water Release keyword. Water Clones can concentrate on jutsu its casts for up to 2 rounds, before its concentration ends. Only 1 Clone can concentrate on a jutsu at a time.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, and the number of Clones you can summon by +1.
